prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square student-laptop promotion poster with a soft pink tiled background. Add the sale header 'TÙNG TỪNG DEAL KHỦNG' and the date 'Duy nhất 1.6 - 31.10' on the top left and a red cellphoneS banner on the top right. Place a large Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 laptop in the center with a purple display wallpaper, plus a smaller side/rear laptop render on the upper right with the callout 'Máy sẵn Office Home 2024'. On the left place a smiling female student with a black backpack, and below her the CellphoneS mascot. Add the title 'Lenovo Yoga Slim 7' with the subline 'Chip AI lên đến 50 TOPS, thiết kế kim loại, tấm nền OLED'. Use a blue student-offer badge, a red pricing bar with 'Giảm thêm đến 1 TRIỆU' and 'Giá Ưu Đãi 37.49 TRIỆU', gift props, and the bottom financing line. Technical style: commercial student-laptop promotion poster, bright retail-student campaign lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark layout, incorrect text, wrong laptop proportions, low resolution, distorted model, clutter, watermark, signature
